explanation: A many-to-many relationship is mapped using a separate associative table. Each row represents one employee-project association, with foreign keys to both parent tables.

options.text: A separate assignment table that stores one row per employee-project pair
A single employee table with a comma-separated list of projects
A single project table with a comma-separated list of employees
Two unrelated tables with no link between them

prompt: A company wants to record which employees are assigned to which projects. Which table design best represents the assignment relationship itself?
